e.title: OpenInsurance
e.summary: 开源 MCP：把国家保险监管文件变成互联 wiki 知识库（country-agnostic）
e.body: OpenInsurance 是开源的 MCP 框架：把一国公开保险监管文件转化为丰富互联的知识库（country-agnostic，可适配任意国家）。对本站：与 Risk Atlas 理念同构（保险知识互联化）——可借鉴它处理监管文件（如 [[rim534]] 保险法域）的结构化思路；与 [[librarian-mcp]]（wiki MCP）、[[llm-wiki]]（知识库模式）组成「保险知识 MCP」组。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：仓库描述确认（监管文件→互联知识库 MCP），未实测
e.summary_en: Open-source MCP: turn a country's public insurance documents into an interconnected wiki knowledge base (country-agnostic)
e.summary_hk: 開源 MCP：把國家保險監管文件變成互聯 wiki 知識庫（country-agnostic）
e.body_en: OpenInsurance is an open-source MCP framework: transforming a country's public insurance regulatory documents into a rich, interconnected knowledge base (country-agnostic, adaptable to any nation). For this site: conceptually isomorphic with Risk Atlas (interconnected insurance knowledge) — its structured approach to regulatory documents (such as the [[rim534]] insurance-law domain) is worth borrowing; with [[librarian-mcp]] (wiki MCP) and [[llm-wiki]] (knowledge-base pattern) it forms an insurance-knowledge MCP trio.
e.body_hk: OpenInsurance 是開源的 MCP 框架：把一國公開保險監管文件轉化為豐富互聯的知識庫（country-agnostic，可適配任意國家）。對本站：與 Risk Atlas 理念同構（保險知識互聯化）——可借鑑它處理監管文件（如 [[rim534]] 保險法域）的結構化思路；與 [[librarian-mcp]]（wiki MCP）、[[llm-wiki]]（知識庫模式）組成「保險知識 MCP」組。
